title: Children's Visual Art 1
description: Register Here Starting August 11! Registration for all Aurora Cultural Centre programs is on the Town of Aurora’s e-PLAY website. All programs continue to be part of the Aurora Cultural Centre. September 27 – November 22, 2025 [SKIP October 11] Saturdays | 10:00 – 11:30 am | Ages 4-7 Aurora Town Square – Shining Hill Visual Arts Studio B 50 Victoria Street, Aurora In this engaging visual arts program for children aged 4 to 7, young artists meet a new artist in every session, exploring their unique styles and perspectives while discovering how creativity can be inspired by the world around them. Each fun-filled class builds artistic skills and encourages self-expression through age-appropriate projects, resulting in completed artworks by the end of the term.
